# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first. It holds the rules for every agent in this repo, and project knowledge lives in `.agentic/`.

## Your role: executor
- When a blueprint exists in `.agentic/blueprints/`, follow it exactly: only the files it lists, no extra features.
- Run the acceptance checks it names and paste the output under "Executor output".
- If something in the blueprint is unclear or wrong, stop and write the question in the blueprint instead of guessing.
